note: R1-6a (docs/work-orders/reflections/R1-6-design.md section 7): what dirties the sky radiance map and how often it is rebuilt. ab_matrix at plains_eye, clocks held, baseline = today (Realtime). Variants: Incremental and Quality modes; atmo_frozen = DaySideAtmosphere process disabled (no sky material writes at all; with clocks held its inputs are constant, so nothing visible changes); atmo_frozen_fog_match = also the main Environment's seven fog values set to the far Environment's (engine defaults, fog stays off), removing the suspected main/far fog flip; atmo_frozen_incremental. Read gpu_total_p50 and the per-viewport vp.*.gpu_p50 deltas. Run: tools/perf_bench.ps1 -Label refl_r16a -ScenarioFile tools/fixtures/perf_bench_sky_radiance_cadence.json

plains_eye.notes: Plains on a 1.5 km ring, ground 741 m
